cards.name: Screenshot zoom with highlighter
cards.summary: A screenshot of an article, post or document sits on a dark desk; the frame pushes in on one line and a yellow marker stroke sweeps across it.
use_for: quoting a tweet, post, headline or report line on screen
avoid: unreadable sources: capture at 2x or more so the zoomed text stays sharp
fabricated or altered screenshots (show the real source, with the date)
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). The scene's 'cam' is the vfx CAM null (a 2D zoom, not a 3D camera): [t0, [anchor x, anchor y, scale], t1, [...], ease]; the anchor point ends up in the centre of frame, so [760, 420, 190] centres that comp point at 190%. Layer 0 (DESK) must not use the CAM (it is created right after layer 0). The footage 'zoom' 0.45 = contain-fit / cover-fit for the 1080x1350 still (0.8 / 1.778), so the whole page shows. The highlight sits ON TOP with blend MULTIPLY (raster text below shows through) and, as a CAM child, its stroke width is divided by the CAM scale (vfx_build.jsx), so 40 means 40 px on screen after the zoom: size it to the zoomed text height and draw it after the push settles. Replace still.png and the line coordinates with the real screenshot's.
built_from: Parenting, null objects and Create Nulls From Paths

verified.note: The still sits on the dark desk, the frame pushes in on it, then the marker stroke sweeps across one line; with blend MULTIPLY over the saturated test still it reads brown, as multiply over a white page would read yellow.

cards.name: Paper drop-in
cards.summary: A document drops into frame from above onto a dark desk, lands with a slight tilt and settles, with a soft contact shadow.
use_for: introducing a letter, order, FIR, report or contract
avoid: more than one or two drops per minute
unreadable pages: follow with a zoom on the line that matters
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). Footage 'zoom' 0.4 puts the 1080x1350 page at about 768x960 px. Position falls from y -700 to 560 in 0.55 s with ease 'out' (fast start, soft landing) while rotation goes -9 -> -3 degrees, then a second rotation seg settles to -2. Drop Shadow values are in the page's own pixels and the layer is scaled about 71%, so 22 px reads as about 16. Add an 'impact' or paper SFX at 0.75 s.

verified.note: The page drops in from above, lands with a slight tilt and settles on the desk with a soft contact shadow.

cards.name: Redaction bars wipe on
cards.summary: Black bars wipe across sensitive lines of a document one by one, the classic redaction look.
use_for: protecting names, numbers or addresses in a shown document
a 'what they did not want you to see' beat
avoid: using it as real redaction: the source pixels are still in the project and the .aep (redact the image itself before import for anything legally sensitive)
cards.keyframes_note: Scenes for vfx.render_scenes(scenes, aep, out_dir) at its defaults (1920x1080, 25 fps); segs are [t0, v0, t1, v1, ease] in comp seconds with ease lin | smooth | out | in (ae_lib.jsx seg). Each bar's origin is its left end, so an x scale 0 -> 100 wipes it to the right; bars start 0.2 s apart. Line positions are placeholders on still.png (contained at zoom 0.45, page x 528..1392): move the origins onto the real lines.

verified.note: Black bars wipe across the page one line after another and hold.
